plan.notes: Official SXU 'suggested four-year academic plan' (courses required in the major shown in bold on the source page). The page advises consulting an academic advisor before course selection. The plan page does not print a catalog year; catalog_year reflects the current 2026-2027 SXU Undergraduate Catalog the page is published under. SXU publishes ONE shared suggested plan for the BA and BS in Psychology; it is collected once as the BS plan. Semester rows as printed sum to 18/15/15/15/13/15/15/13 = 119; the page states 120 credit hours are required — plan transcribed exactly as published. Domain option titles: Developmental (PSYCH 199 Lifespan Development / 200 Child Development / 201 Adolescent Development / 224 Adulthood and Aging); Social (206 Social Psychology / 210 Cultural Psychology / 232 Personality Theories / 328 Sex and Gender); Biological (311 Physiological Psychology / 319 Hormones and Behavior / 341 Health Psychology); Cognitive (312 Perception / 313 Learning and Memory / 315 Cognitive Psychology). BS requires 24 credit hours of science-related coursework; BA requires 6 additional hours of foreign language/culture/global studies.
